primary: Combined minus control mean confirmation gain, averaging two repetitions per problem then five problem groups equally.
secondary: All three means and combined-minus-Dream; report problem-level t intervals and sign flips descriptively. No multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim.
default_rule: Compare the complete three-arm problem means; ties retain ParallelRefine. No promotion on incomplete study or development results.
confirmation: Freeze all 30 choices before any confirmation. Same train-only refit; failed confirmation gain -1. Keep every failed attempt and unknown cost.
scope: Five newly specified synthetic mechanism families. One model; not general real-world research capability proof.
shared_adapter_change: Preserve provider_result in scientist feedback, equally for all arms. Earlier trials are not pooled.
reuse: Only reviewed Dream revision 4 source, fixed baseline implementations and executor/model-call code; no old scientific results or prompts reused.
